svg.title: Symmetria PostgreSQL benchmark: latency, throughput and query construction
svg.desc: 2026-10-21T22-14-44-402Z-d39a2a12. Dots show every pass; lines show min to max, never a confidence interval. Each panel has its own zero-based linear scale. Full accessible tables are in benchmarks/report/README.md.

g.text: One workload. Every pass. No overall score.
50 users × up to 3 posts × tags · lower is better
Durable writes · no RETURNING · lower is better
Application operations, not SQL statements · higher is better
Fresh query each time · 100 builds/sample · lower is better
Raw: no query compiler. Prisma: no equivalent sync API.
Prepared OFFSET cases are in the full report.
Dots = individual passes · tick = median · line = min–max · linear axes start at zero · each panel has its own scale
Warm synthetic workload · 2,000 users / 40,000 posts · durability on · environment + limits in full report
